senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. זָךְ) [to be pure, clear,]

units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:7">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>זוֹכֶה בדין</he> he will be successful in his plea before court.
<cite ref="Berakhot 7b:18">Ber. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>זוכה בדין</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he will be found righteous in Divine judgment; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be found worthy of, to be privileged, to succeed. Ib. I, 5 ולא זָכִיתִי וכ׳ I did not succeed (in proving) that &c. Ib. 5ᵇ לא … זוכה לשתי וכ׳ not every one is privileged to enjoy two tables (this world and the hereafter).
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 5b:18">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>תִּזְכּוּ להקביל וכ׳</he> you will be privileged to receive &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 19a:9">Pes. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>זָכִינוּ שאין וכ׳</he> it was a good thing for us that &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:13">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ תאוות וכ׳</he> if one is favored, ‘thou givest him the desire of his heart’ (without prayer), if less favored &c.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:3">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00119"><he>נֶגֶד</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to take possession, have authority; to own (cmp. קָנָה); to gain, obtain a privilege.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:3">B. Mets. I, 3</cite> <he>אני זָכִיתִי בה</he> I took possession of it for myself; <he>ז׳ בה</he> it is his. Ib. 4 <he>זה שהחזיק בה ז׳ בה</he> the one that took a hold of it, is the legitimate owner.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:3">Ib.</cite> <he>זָכְתָה לי שדי</he> my field (in which the object lies) has taken possession for me.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:3:8">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᵃ</cite> top <he>הראוי לִזְכּוֹת ע״י עצמו וכ׳</he> he who is legally qualified to acquire ownership through his own act, can obtain ownership through another person.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 7:11">Erub. VII, 11</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 81b:13">81ᵇ</cite>), a. fr. <he>זָכִין לאדם שלא בפניו</he> you may obtain a privilege in behalf of a person in his absence, but you cannot act in his behalf to his disadvantage; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (v. Pi.) to benefit another person by one’s own merit, to transfer blessing &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:9">Eduy. II, 9</cite> <he>האב זוֹכֶה לבן וכ׳</he> a (good) father transmits to his son the benefits of beauty &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Eduyot 1:14">Tosef. ib. I, 14</cite> <he>עד הפרק זוכה לו</he> up to the age of majority the father’s merit stands by him, <he>מכאן ואילך זוכה לעצמו</he> after that he lives on his own merits.

senses.gloss: to deserve well of, be of service to.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:14">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 41:2">Ps. XLI, 2</cite>) <he>הוי … היאך לִזְכּוֹת עמו</he> reflect well how to be of real service to him.
<cite ref="Psalms 41:2">Ib.</cite> <he>לזכות בו</he> to deserve divine reward through him.
<cite ref="Psalms 41:2">Ib.</cite> <he>שיהו זָכִין אלו לאלו</he> that they may deserve well of each other (the poor being the instrumentality of bliss to the giver); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to acquit, to argue or vote for acquittal.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 19a:5">Erub. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>יפה זִכִּיתָ וכ׳</he> thou wast right in acquitting, in condemning.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:5">Snh. III, 5</cite> <he>שנים מְזַכִּין</he> if two vote for acquittal; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to obtain a privilege for, take possession in behalf of; to transfer, make an assignment to. Y. Kidd. l. c. זה זי׳ לבן דעת the one obtained a privilege for a rational being.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 8:6">B. Bath. VIII, 6</cite> <he>זי׳ בה לאחר</he> if in his will (found on his body) he made an assignment to somebody else (as executor); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to transfer divine favor, to exercise a protecting influence on.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 111a:4">Snh. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>מְזַכֶּה את כל וכ׳</he> protects the entire town.

<cite ref="Yoma 87a:4">Yoma 87ᵃ</cite> <he>לא דיין שזוכין לעצמן אלא שמְזַכִּין וכ׳</he> Ms. M. not only do they obtain divine grace for themselves, but they also transfer the same on their children &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to lead to righteousness, to convert, make better, purer. Ib.; Ab. V, 18, a. e. כל המזכה את וכ׳ whoever causes a community to do good.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:16">Macc. III, 16</cite> <he>רצה הקב״ה לזַכּוֹת וכ׳</he>, the Lord desired to make Israel pure; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be acquitted, to be found not guilty.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 30a:18">Snh. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>מדבריהם נז׳ פלוני</he> the defendant has been acquitted by their (the court’s) verdict. Y. ib. V, 22ᵈ top <he>ובאיזו מִזְדַּכֶּה פוטרין אותו</he> and on which-soever (of the two counts) he is found not guilty, he is acquitted; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to have favorable evidence or argument offered. Ib. 23ᵃ נ׳ מפי עצמו if the defendant himself offers &c. Ib. הרי שנ׳ מפי עצמו (read מפי עדו).
